items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: He used to play in his sports brass band. The Allen band. Old man Allen... He played bass drum.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. He used to play in his sports brass band. The Allen band. Old man Allen. He had a good brass band.
Did Little Red play snare or bass? Who? The young one.

He played bass drum. He goes laughing bass drum. It's crazy as hell. Mm-hmm. He's counting the fruit of the one. The funnest thing when this boy died, he come down to the barry's ball. And I sent him to the barry's ball. And I sent him to the barry's ball. He said, he's going to be coming down. I said, what's your own? He said, they been telling me how you used to kill my dad. I said, yeah, I can. Yeah, I used to kill him. I can. He said, put it on my mind. Yeah, I know, man. He said, oh man. He said, oh man. He…
